_doc: Skill-level defaults, merged under <work>/config/project.config.json by lib/config.{py,js}. Today these ARE the configuration: SKILL.md step 2 reads them and asks nothing. The creator's own values (handle, language, theme) live here deliberately — this is a personal fork with one creator; per-project configuration comes back in a later version, and lifting these back out is a one-line change.
